config.script:

		system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-initials", "BlueRidge/Components/Popups/InitialsEntry", params={"popupId": "mpp-initials"}, modal=True, showCloseIcon=False, overlayDismiss=False)

customMethods.name: loadTrace
customMethods.script:
if not lotId:
		return
	self.view.custom.selectedLotId = lotId
	self.view.custom.lot = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getOrEmpty(lotId=lotId)
	self.view.custom.history = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getHistory(lotId)
	self.view.custom.scrap = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getScrapSummaryOrEmpty(lotId)
	self.view.custom.events = BlueRidge.Lots.GlobalTrace.productionEventRows(lotId)
	self.view.custom.genealogy = BlueRidge.Lots.GlobalTrace.genealogyRows(lotId)

customMethods.name: loadDetail
customMethods.script:
self.view.custom.activeMatchType = matchType or ""
	d = BlueRidge.Lots.GlobalTrace.loadDetail(
		matchType, matchedEntityId, self.view.custom.searchText)
	self.view.custom.serialDetail = d["serialDetail"]
	self.view.custom.containerDetail = d["containerDetail"]
	self.view.custom.containerSerials = d["containerSerials"]
	self.view.custom.containerHolds = d["containerHolds"]
